subject.title: fix(msteams): emit native cjs runtime entrypoints

question: Should this PR require an exact-head packed or installed msteams startup smoke before merge, or is the current artifact-level proof plus verified loader contract sufficient?
rationale: The code and generated artifacts are correct, but changing the published module format is compatibility-sensitive and the remaining installed-startup risk can only be accepted or gated by an owner.

options.title: Require installed startup proof
options.body: Obtain an exact-head packed or installed msteams startup transcript before merging the module-format change.

options.title: Accept current proof
options.body: Merge using the generated-artifact proof and verified tsdown and loader contracts, accepting the bounded first-load interoperability risk.

recommendation.title: Require installed startup proof
recommendation.body: Obtain an exact-head packed or installed msteams startup transcript before merging the module-format change.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent introduced and most recently maintained the centralized package-runtime build and manifest path affected by this choice.
